features.title: Add a metadata-enriched web bookmark
features.description: Implement the complete add flow from the existing Note Editor Basic Blocks Advanced panel. Add the backward-compatible EditorBlock.WebBookmarkBlock model and JSON serialization, bounded HTTP(S) validation, a dedicated unauthenticated HTTPS metadata data source with bounded HTML parsing and host/blank fallback, ViewModel-owned Add/Edit URL state, and a note-scoped Navigation Compose destination using the approved full-page layout. The destination must accept only the URL, pin Save and Cancel to the bottom safe area, show loading and validation states, preserve draft state through recreation, insert after the focused block or append, and autosave through the existing note repository without mutating unrelated blocks.
features.user_visible_behavior: From Basic Blocks > Advanced, an editable user can open a full-page Add Web Bookmark screen, enter only a web address, save it, and return to see a metadata-derived bookmark card. The keyboard state keeps the bottom Save and Cancel actions reachable.

features.title: Complete bookmark management, export, and visual verification
features.description: Implement the persisted bookmark card's open and mutation behavior, then close the feature's export, compatibility, and visual-verification contract. Add stable semantic/test tags, the single More/actions control, the existing EditorNoteActionsSheet/SheetActionRow visual treatment for Edit and Delete, the full-page Edit destination with same-block identity, confirmation-gated deletion, read-only guards, and the Android ACTION_VIEW browser launcher with validated URI resolution and recoverable no-handler feedback. Preserve stable order and autosave semantics for edits and deletes. Export plain text, Markdown, and PDF context/URLs without network work; keep legacy and malformed content readable and safe; capture the completed editor/card, URL-only full page from the production app shell, keyboard state, actions sheet, and responsive states from source-fed instrumented visual flows against the approved design assets. The real platform test must exercise the Android intent/package-manager boundary on an emulator rather than a fake callback.
features.user_visible_behavior: A saved bookmark card exposes Open and one More control. More opens a standard app-style bottom sheet with Edit and Delete rows; Edit opens the URL-only full page, Delete opens confirmation, read-only notes hide mutations, and Open launches the validated URL in the external browser. Export preserves bookmark context and URLs without fetching; malformed/legacy content remains safe; the complete flow remains readable and unclipped across approved theme, RTL, scale, IME, and layout states.
